author: nichmor
source: PFX-1938 independent no-PURL audit: remove the unrelated Shadowsocks-libev application CPE from the libev event-loop library. Exact artifact https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/osx-64/libev-4.33-ha3d0635_3.conda (SHA256 223314a7476bdeb00f698937b6960fc51cb98627af2ac5a629e5150bcddb8abf) contains include/ev.h, include/ev++.h, lib/libev.4.dylib and its symlink; its homepage is https://software.schmorp.de/pkg/libev.html and build metadata identifies https://github.com/conda-forge/libev-feedstock/tree/865d6e94ceab52b90efb1658293f4d63f3cc6e69. In contrast, https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-libev/blob/d52ddf2bcee97d799c74f54bf63533351a05324c/README.md describes the distinct Shadowsocks proxy application historically built around libev. Explicitly replace the prior CPE list with an empty list; do not infer a replacement PURL or CPE, change the legacy primary disposition, or claim the library has no vulnerabilities.
